tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Get the public company identity, contact details and scalable hauling capabilities.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List public hauling services with page links.

tools.name: get_service_areas
tools.description: Get North Carolina coverage and city pages. Optionally pass city, county, state or ZIP for preliminary geographic review; does not confirm project acceptance.

tools.name: get_fleet_capabilities
tools.description: Get public fleet size, Mack Granite equipment, typical payload, statewide coverage and scalable independent partner capacity. No live availability.

tools.name: check_fleet_availability
tools.description: Get the dispatch contact for owned and partner truck capacity confirmation; no live inventory.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Get the project bid form and checklist; does not submit a quote or send a message. Optional structured project details produce a preliminary review and inquiry checklist; no submission or booking.

tools.name: request_subcontracting
tools.description: Get the partnership inquiry route; does not submit or send a message.

tools.name: check_project_eligibility
tools.description: Get project fit criteria, including larger projects supported by partner carriers; not a binding eligibility decision. tools.name: submit_project_inquiry
tools.description: Send a hauling inquiry to Sinai via Formspree only after explicit user approval of the exact data. Not a booking or quote. Contact identity is not verified. Privacy: https://sinaicorp.com/privacy.html. Rate limits apply; never retry automatically.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service_areas, request_quote, request_subcontracting, check_project_eligibility · Private data: get_company_profile, check_fleet_availability, submit_project_inquiry · Public sink: request_quote, request_subcontracting, submit_project_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service_areas, request_quote, request_subcontracting, check_project_eligibility · Private data: get_company_profile, check_fleet_availability, submit_project_inquiry · Public sink: request_quote, request_subcontracting, submit_project_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
